description.value: Scoops by the Sea is an outdoor ice cream stand in Chemainus, BC, tucked behind a building across from the local visitor center. The shop handcrafts all its ice cream in-store daily, with an extensive roster of signature flavours, rotating seasonal specials, and a full vegan and dairy-free lineup using water-based sorbets, coconut milk, and cashew milk. Beyond ice cream, they serve gourmet beef hotdogs, milkshakes, frappes, iced coffee, and freshly squeezed lemonade — making it a rewarding treat stop for touring cyclists passing through this historic waterfront town.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM record: address 9779 Willow St, Chemainus BC matches OSM, phone 403-975-4211 matches OSM, and the business is confirmed active as an outdoor ice cream kiosk across from the visitor center. The website explicitly offers dairy-free and vegan options (water-based sorbets, coconut milk, cashew milk ice creams) and the all-outdoor, takeout-only format is clearly described. No evidence for bike parking, water refills, or on-site washrooms appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Phone area code 403 is an Alberta (Calgary) area code, not a BC area code — likely reflects an owner who relocated from Alberta, but worth noting in case of a data entry error.
OSM opening hours (Tue + Thu–Sun, 12:30–17:30) conflict with website ('Open Daily 12–6'); OSM data may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active outdoor ice cream kiosk in Chemainus, BC with a well-maintained website, confirmed contact details, and a food offering well-suited to touring cyclists.
